# VoiceTodo

VoiceTodo is an iPhone to-do app you talk to: say one sentence with several tasks and it becomes a clean checklist with the right dates. Check tasks off from Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets. No account; your list stays on your iPhone. Free to start (3 voice captures/day), Pro adds 100/day with a 7-day free trial. English, Chinese, and Japanese. Requires iPhone with iOS 26 or later.

Main pages:

- https://voicetodo.example.com/voice-to-do-list — voice capture
- https://voicetodo.example.com/lock-screen-to-do-list — Lock Screen widgets
